tests.name: audio_content_hash

checks.what: audio element has the job's audio.wav URL
page is a secure context (crypto.subtle available on 127.0.0.1)
in-page fetch of audio.wav: 200 audio/wav
WAV header: PCM, mono, 16 kHz, 16-bit
WAV data chunk length equals manifest pcm_bytes
SHA-256 of the PCM bytes received by the browser equals manifest sha256_pcm
decodeAudioData output: same sample count, 16 kHz, mono (no resampling)
decoded samples -> int16: bit-exact, or within 1 LSB and bit-exact under the decoder's scaling
every decoded float equals Chromium's int16->float conversion of the delivered PCM sample
the samples that differ under Math.round(x*32768) are exactly those the model predicts

notes: Chromium converts int16 to float asymmetrically: float(v)*float(1/32768) for v < 0 and float(v)*float(1/32767) for v >= 0 (media/base/audio_sample_types.h, FixedSampleTypeTraits::To). Math.round(x*32768) therefore returns v+1 for positive samples near or above 16384 (56 of 196800 samples here, all off by exactly 1); the inverse x<0 ? round(x*32768) : round(x*32767) recovers every sample, so the SHA-256 matches.

extra_probes.name: playback_after_cancel

ui_state.now: Lunar EnginesPMR synthetic generatorreprodução progressiva · 3:12 · licença CC0-1.0
ui_state.playState: Reprodução encerrada: a recuperação foi interrompida antes do fim.

notes: After a cancel the WAV header and the 206 Content-Length still announce the whole track. When playback reaches the end of the decrypted audio, the client closes each Range request without data; Chromium logs ERR_CONTENT_LENGTH_MISMATCH, retries the Range request, and the element stays in 'waiting' (no 'ended'/'error'), so the UI keeps polling and posting playback forever.

extra_probes.name: cancel_before_first_block

ui_after_4s.now: Wandering BridgesPMR synthetic generatorreprodução progressiva · 3:02 · licença CC0-1.0
ui_after_4s.playState: Reprodução encerrada: a recuperação foi interrompida antes do fim.

notes: Cancelling before the first block is decrypted makes RetrievalResult.timings['first_block_ms'] = NaN (pirclient.py); json.dumps emits the bare token NaN, which the browser's JSON.parse rejects, so every UI poll of /api/jobs/<id> fails and the page never shows 'cancelada'.
